summary: This note describes the third season of The Biggest Loser Brunei, the Bruneian adaptation of the NBC reality series The Biggest Loser, titled "Lose It All." The title reflects that it is the biggest show in the Brunei series and encourages contestants to keep losing weight both on the ranch and after leaving it. The season premiered March 13, 2012, and introduced trainer Cristine Phoebe, who replaced Juliana Mikael, who did not return for a third season.
one_line: Third season of The Biggest Loser Brunei, subtitled "Lose It All," premiered March 13, 2012 with new trainer Cristine Phoebe.
key_facts: The Biggest Loser Brunei is the Bruneian version of the NBC reality television series The Biggest Loser.
The third season of The Biggest Loser Brunei is titled "Lose It All."
The title "Lose It All" was chosen because this is the biggest show of the Brunei series.
The season's title is meant to encourage contestants to keep losing weight whether on the ranch or outside the ranch.
Cristine Phoebe was introduced as the new trainer for the third season.
Cristine Phoebe replaced Juliana Mikael as trainer.
Juliana Mikael did not return for the third season.
